review_summary: Independently read all six proposed facts' canonical citations in grshrine.c, gr/inlines.h, gr/types.h and lb/lb_00B0.c. All six corrections are supported and agree with functionality.md. Existing supported role-based names and inherited retained knowledge are retained without churn. Section-associated deferrals are accepted; source declarations do not prove compiled allocation. Acceptance is scoped to changes and examined contradictions, not a fresh audit of every inherited retained row.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization stores the accessor return, ignores the three object-helper results, and supplies exactly the documented vector, selector, scalars, angle and bounds.
Row 0 contains this constant-false predicate. The indexed setup invokes an installer that never reads callback1, so table membership does not establish runtime dispatch.
Row 1 contains this constant-false predicate, but the installer neither installs nor invokes callback1. The correction appropriately withdraws unsupported invocation-argument provenance.
The static empty void function occupies row 1 callback3. The canonical member signature is void (Ground_GObj*); normal return without a value is distinct from noreturn.

The shadow wrapper obtains the joint origin and compares Y strictly. The helper calls matrix setup for parented joints and dereferences the null local-offset pointer if the joint is null, supporting both qualifications.
Only greater-than returns true; equal, lower and unordered comparisons return false. No local persistent state or null guards exist, while delegated matrix setup precludes a blanket no-effects claim.

contradictions.reason: Resolved the initialization return-value contradiction: Ground_GetYakumonoParam's result is consumed by assignment. Proposal index 0 preserves the remaining supported data flow.
Resolved both predicate-dispatch claims through proposal indices 1 and 2. Callback-row association is supported; this installer does not establish actual callback1 dispatch or argument provenance.
Resolved the misleading no-return characterization through proposal index 3: the empty void callback returns normally.

Resolved both shadow-wrapper overstatements through proposal indices 4 and 5. Local statelessness does not exclude delegated joint effects; the helper performs parented-joint matrix setup, and the strict comparison also returns false when unordered.
Accepted deferral of the .data disposition: initialized callback-table and descriptor declarations establish source order, not compiled writable-section membership or layout.

Accepted deferral of all three .rodata fact dispositions and the .rodata implements link. The local vector and its initialization use are supported; identifying emitted read-only storage requires compiled evidence.

Accepted deferral of all four .sbss dispositions. The opaque static pointer, assignment and lack of later local consumption are supported, but compiled-section identity and the accessor's upstream field are not established by this source.
Accepted deferral of all three .sdata2 dispositions. Numeric expressions do not establish constant-pool membership, section contents or padding; no compiled allocation claim is adopted.
